# Beat Lab — AI music guide

The published, world-readable copy of the guide you paste into an AI chat to
compose for the Beat Lab engine. Served by GitHub Pages:

- https://instush.github.io/beatlab-guide/beat-music-guide.txt — the guide (plain text, paste or download)
- https://instush.github.io/beatlab-guide/music-guide.md — same contract, generated markdown form
- https://instush.github.io/beatlab-guide/docs/music-reference.md — full score-language reference
- https://instush.github.io/beatlab-guide/docs/music-score.schema.json — JSON Schema for a score

**Do not edit these files here.** They are generated from the (private) Beat Lab
app and pushed by its `npm run publish-guide` command; hand edits are overwritten
on the next publish. Only the guide is public — the engine source is not.
